description: Create a Coinbase Onramp checkout URL for buying ETH or USDC on base, ethereum, arbitrum or optimism into wallet_address, in two calls: sign the returned ownership_proof.message with wallet_address, then call again with issued_at and signature. Show the URL to the user; Coinbase handles identity checks and payment on its own page. Live or sandbox per this server's configuration: the result's environment says which, and real_payment is true only for live checkouts.

asset.description: Crypto to buy: ETH or USDC

network.description: Network the purchase is delivered on; default base

payment_amount.description: Fiat amount to pre-fill including fees, in major units (e.g. 50 or 49.99), not base units. Omit to let the user choose

payment_currency.description: Fiat currency the user pays with; default USD

wallet_address.description: EVM address that receives the purchase, normally the user's own wallet

name: create_coinbase_onramp_link
title: Create a Coinbase Onramp checkout link
